$comment: Engine strings for resolved visual specs (VSL-14, VSL-19, LOC-01): part names and alt-text templates, keyed per kind. Placeholders in braces are filled from the resolved spec only; a model never writes these.

alt.geometry_circle: A circle of radius {radius} with a sector angle of {angle} degrees.
alt.geometry_theorem: A circle theorem figure, {meaning}: the given angle is {given} degrees, so the marked angle is {derived} degrees.
alt.geometry_parallel: Two parallel lines cut by a transversal, with the eight angles named a to h{given}. {pairs}
alt.pair_corresponding: Corresponding angles a and e are equal.
alt.pair_alternate: Alternate angles c and e are equal.
alt.pair_co_interior: Co-interior angles d and e add up to 180 degrees.
alt.pair_vertically_opposite: Vertically opposite angles a and c are equal.
alt.unit_circle: A unit circle with an angle of {angle} degrees: {ratios}.
alt.statistics_box: A box plot: minimum {min}, lower quartile {q1}, median {median}, upper quartile {q3}, maximum {max}.
alt.bearing_diagram: {to} is on a bearing of {bearing} degrees from {from}, {distance} away; the back bearing is {back} degrees.
alt.motion_graph: A {graph} graph through {count} points, from {first} to {last}.
alt.state_solid: solid: closely packed in a regular pattern
alt.energy_profile: An energy profile for an {reaction} reaction from {reactants} to {products}{energies}.
alt.journal_entry: A journal entry: {lines}; debits total {debit} and credits total {credit}.
alt.bank_reconciliation: A bank reconciliation: the updated cash book balance is {cash}; {lines}.
alt.break_even_chart: A break-even chart: fixed costs {fixed}, break-even at {units} units and revenue {revenue}{margin}.
alt.transformation_grid: A {kind} maps the object {object} to the image {image}.
alt.motion_diagram: Positions of an object at {marks} equal time intervals along a {axis} line; initial velocity {u}, acceleration {a}.
alt.free_body: A free-body diagram of a {object} with forces: {forces}.
alt.ray_diagram: A ray diagram for a {optic}: object {u} from the optic, image {v} from the optic, {nature}, magnification {m}.
alt.t_account_balance: {account} has a balance carried down of {amount} on the {side} side
alt.trial_balance: A trial balance with debit total {debit} and credit total {credit}{agree}.
alt.titration_curve: A titration curve: pH starts at {start} and the equivalence point is at {volume} with pH {ph}.
alt.projectile_sim: A projectile simulation, {mode} launch at {speed} metres per second from {height} metres: range {range} metres, time of flight {time} seconds.
alt.circuit_sim: A circuit simulation with a {emf} V cell and {count} resistors in {arrangement}; the current is {current} A.
alt.titration_sim: A titration simulation: {base} added to {volume} cubic centimetres of {acid}; the end point is at {end} cubic centimetres.
alt.circuit_sim_predict: A circuit simulation with a {emf} V cell and {count} resistors in {arrangement}. It runs after you predict, so the result is not given here.
alt.titration_sim_predict: A titration simulation: {base} will be added to {volume} cubic centimetres of {acid}. It runs after you predict, so the result is not given here.
alt.gas_laws_sim: A gas laws simulation: a gas in a {container} at {temperature} K and {volume} cubic centimetres, with the {control} as the control; the pressure is {pressure} kPa.
alt.gas_laws_sim_predict: A gas laws simulation: a gas in a {container} at {temperature} K and {volume} cubic centimetres, with the {control} as the control. It runs after you predict, so the result is not given here.
alt.function_transform_sim: A graph transformation simulation: y = a f(b(x + c)) + d with f(x) = {expression}, a = {a}, b = {b}, c = {c} and d = {d}; the tracked point is at ({x}, {y}).
alt.function_transform_sim_predict: A graph transformation simulation: y = a f(b(x + c)) + d with f(x) = {expression}, a = {a}, b = {b} and d = {d}. It runs after you predict, so the result is not given here.
alt.electrolysis_sim: An electrolysis simulation: {phase} {electrolyte} with {electrodes} electrodes, {current} A for {duration} seconds; {cathode} forms at the cathode and {anode} at the anode.
alt.electrolysis_sim_predict: An electrolysis simulation: {phase} {electrolyte} with {electrodes} electrodes, {current} A for {duration} seconds. It runs after you predict, so the result is not given here.
alt.rates_sim: A reaction rate simulation at {temperature} K with a reactant concentration of {concentration} mol per cubic decimetre: the rate constant is {k} per second and the reaction is all but over after {time} seconds.
alt.rates_sim_predict: A reaction rate simulation at {temperature} K with a reactant concentration of {concentration} mol per cubic decimetre. It runs after you predict, so the result is not given here.
alt.equilibrium_sim: An equilibrium simulation of {equation} at {temperature} K, where Kc is {kc}; at equilibrium the concentrations in mol per cubic decimetre are {equilibrium}.
alt.equilibrium_sim_predict: An equilibrium simulation of {equation} at {temperature} K. It runs after you predict, so the result is not given here.
